name: viberaven
description: VibeRaven Studio and production-context skills for AI-built apps.

interface.shortDescription: Give agents release and production context before fixes.
interface.longDescription: Open the VibeRaven Studio with npx -y viberaven, or install the skills pack so coding agents carry what changed, why it is dangerous, which provider boundary matters, and what proof remains before editing.
defaultPrompt: Use VibeRaven when an AI-built app needs release, provider, or production context before a fix.
Use what-broke to find what changed before editing.
Use go-live when the user wants GitHub push, Vercel deploy, and live URL proof.
